units.source_text: 那女人也觉得奇怪，百思不得其解。

en.t: The woman also found it strange and could not make sense of it no matter how much she thought.

units.source_text: 因此每逢使者送了信回去时，便派人追踪。

en.t: So whenever the messenger delivered a letter and returned, she sent someone to follow him.

units.source_text: 破晓公子出门时，也派人窥察他的去向，探究他的住处。

en.t: When the young lord left at daybreak, she also had people watch where he went and try to discover where he lived.

units.source_text: 然而公子行踪诡秘，总不给她抓住线索。

en.t: But the young lord moved so secretively that he never let her catch hold of any clue.

units.source_text: 虽然如此艰辛，公子对她总是恋恋不舍，非常常见面不可。

en.t: Though it was so difficult, the young lord remained deeply attached to her and could not help seeing her again and again.

units.source_text: 即使有时反省，觉得此乃不应有之轻率行为，痛自悔恨，然而还是屡屡前去幽会。

en.t: Even when he reflected on himself, felt that this was an improper and reckless act, and bitterly regretted it, he still went repeatedly to their secret meetings.

units.source_text: 原来关于男女之事，即使谨严之人，有时也会迷乱失措。

en.t: In matters between men and women, it turns out that even the most restrained person may sometimes lose judgment and composure.

units.source_text: 源氏公子一向谨慎小心，不做受人讥评之事，然而此次奇怪之极：

en.t: Lord Genji had always been cautious and careful, never doing anything that would invite criticism, yet this time his conduct was exceedingly strange:

units.source_text: 早晨分手不久，便已想念不置；

en.t: not long after parting from her in the morning, he was already unable to stop thinking of her;

units.source_text: 晚间会面之前，早就焦灼盼待。

en.t: and long before their evening meeting, he was already waiting in burning impatience.

units.source_text: 一面又强自镇定，认为此乃一时着魔，并非真心热爱。

en.t: At the same time, he forced himself to remain calm, telling himself that this was only a passing enchantment and not true love.

units.source_text: 他想：“此人风度异常温柔绰约，缺少沉着稳重之趣，独多浪漫活泼之态，却又不是未经人事之处女。

en.t: He thought, “Her manner is unusually gentle and graceful; she lacks the charm of composure and steadiness, and has instead a romantic, lively air, yet she is not an innocent maiden untouched by experience.

units.source_text: 出身亦不甚高贵。

en.t: Her birth is not especially noble either.

units.source_text: 那么她到底有什么好处，故能如此牵惹我心呢？”

en.t: Then what virtue does she possess that can draw my heart so strongly?”

units.source_text: 反复考虑，自己也觉得不可思议。

en.t: Turning it over again and again, he himself found it incomprehensible.

units.source_text: 他非常小心：穿上一身粗陋的便服，样子完全改变，连面孔也遮蔽，不教人看清。

en.t: He was extremely cautious: he put on a set of rough everyday clothes, changed his appearance completely, and even covered his face so that no one could see him clearly.

units.source_text: 夜深人静之时，偷偷地出入这人家，宛如旧小说中的狐狸精。

en.t: In the deep quiet of night, he slipped secretly in and out of this house, like a fox spirit from an old tale.

units.source_text: 因此夕颜心中怀疑，不免恐惧悲叹。

en.t: Because of this, Yugao grew suspicious in her heart and could not help feeling fear and sorrow.

units.source_text: 然而他那优越的品貌，即使暗中摸索，也可分明觉察。

en.t: Yet his exceptional bearing and beauty could be clearly sensed even by touch in the dark.

units.source_text: 夕颜想道：“这究竟是何等样人呢？

en.t: Yugao wondered, “What sort of person can he possibly be?

units.source_text: 多分是邻家那个好色鬼带来的吧。”

en.t: Most likely he was brought here by that lecher from next door.”

units.source_text: 她怀疑那个惟光。

en.t: She suspected Koremitsu.

units.source_text: 惟光却假装不知，仿佛完全没有注意这件事，照旧兴高采烈地在此进进出出。

en.t: Koremitsu, however, pretended to know nothing and, as if he had noticed nothing at all, continued cheerfully coming and going there as usual.

units.source_text: 夕颜弄得莫名其妙，只得暗自沉思，其烦闷与一般的恋爱是不一样的。

en.t: Yugao was left utterly bewildered and could only brood in secret; her distress was unlike that of an ordinary love affair.
